newsitem.title: USA: Flores & Rucks offshore find in production.
newsitem.headline: Flores & Rucks offshore find in production.

text.p: Flores & Rucks Inc said Tuesday it has a 50 percent working interest in a discovery offshore Louisiana that was completed at the rate of 19.8 million cubic feet of natural gas and 131 barrels of condensate per day.
Sales started from the State Lease 13262 No. 3 well on the company's Midnight prospect on September 4, it said.
A Noble Affiliates Inc subsidiary is operator of the well and owner of the other 50 percent.
Located in South Pass Block 41, the discovery was drilled to 10,500 feet.
It encountered about 173 net feet of natural gas and condensate pay in three sands as determined from electric log, Flores & Ruckes said.
